What's new in 0.1.69:
• Story Studio (In development, owner only): turn a story into a short animated cartoon with Beebo and Appa, made on your own computer.
• Moving backgrounds: swaying trees, drifting clouds, rolling water, a glowing moon, stars and birds.
• Voices no longer talk over each other in exported videos.
• Beebo is always the rabbit in the storybooks; he wears a costume in stories that used to make him another animal.
